brief: Build a local MVP web app for Sudoku solving with a React + Vite frontend and Python 3.11 FastAPI backend implementing the Norvig Method solver. The app allows manual 9x9 board input, validates input, sends puzzles to the backend for solving, and displays the solved board plus a basic solving log.

meta.product_goal: Create a working local Sudoku solver prototype with minimal complexity for local use in browser.
meta.freeform_notes: This is a simple, local MVP web app strictly following the detailed V1 acceptance criteria and complexity budget as outlined. All deferred V2 features will be skipped in this phase. Simple local MVP only. OCR/image upload is explicitly deferred to V2. Docker/CI/Playwright/browser automation are deferred to V2 unless added later as a separate integration QA task.
